<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Feature\Navigation;

use App\Enums\UserRole;
use App\Models\Team;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\View;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Test;
use Tests\Feature\FeatureTestCase;

/**
 * Capsule T3 — mobile primary navigation active state + scroll restoration contract.
 *
 * The rendered contract under test:
 *   - a current primary nav link is programmatically current (aria-current="page"),
 *     in the mobile variant as well as the desktop one, and exactly once per variant;
 *   - every primary nav link carries a stable, item-derived scroll-restoration key
 *     (data-scroll-key) that is identical for the desktop and mobile rendering of
 *     the same item;
 *   - the authenticated layout emits a scroll-restoration region marker
 *     (data-scroll-region) identifying the page being rendered;
 *   - existing filtering / badge / href / test-id behaviour is unchanged.
 */
class MobileNavScrollStateTest extends FeatureTestCase
{
    /**
     * @return array<int, array<string, mixed>>
     */
    private function navItems(): array
    {
        return [
            [
                'key' => 'tenant-dashboard',
                'label' => 'Dashboard',
                'route' => 'user.dashboard',
                'data_testid' => 'nav-dashboard',
                'active' => true,
            ],
            [
                'key' => 'tenant-events',
                'label' => 'Events',
                'route' => 'events.index',
                'data_testid' => 'nav-events',
                'active' => false,
                'badge' => 7,
            ],
            [
                'key' => 'tenant-billing',
                'label' => 'Billing',
                'route' => 'billing.index',
                'data_testid' => 'nav-billing',
                'active' => false,
            ],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<int, array<string, mixed>>  $items
     * @param  array<int, string>  $except
     */
    private function renderNav(string $variant, array $items, array $except = []): string
    {
        return View::make('components.topbar-navigation', [
            'items' => $items,
            'variant' => $variant,
            'except' => $except,
        ])->render();
    }

    /**
     * Parse the rendered anchors into testid => attribute map so assertions read
     * the contract, not the markup ordering or class strings.
     *
     * @return array<string, array<string, string|null>>
     */
    private function links(string $html): array
    {
        preg_match_all('/<a\b[^>]*>/s', $html, $matches);

        $links = [];

        foreach ($matches[0] as $tag) {
            $attribute = static function (string $name) use ($tag): ?string {
                return preg_match('/\b' . preg_quote($name, '/') . '="([^"]*)"/', $tag, $found)
                    ? $found[1]
                    : null;
            };

            $testid = $attribute('data-testid');

            if ($testid === null) {
                continue;
            }

            $links[$testid] = [
                'href' => $attribute('href'),
                'aria-current' => $attribute('aria-current'),
                'data-scroll-key' => $attribute('data-scroll-key'),
            ];
        }

        return $links;
    }

    #[Test]
    public function current_item_is_programmatically_current_in_both_variants(): void
    {
        $items = $this->navItems();

        $desktop = $this->links($this->renderNav('desktop', $items));
        $mobile = $this->links($this->renderNav('mobile', $items));

        $this->assertCount(3, $desktop);
        $this->assertCount(3, $mobile);

        // AC1 — current-ness is exposed programmatically, in both variants.
        $this->assertSame('page', $desktop['nav-dashboard']['aria-current']);
        $this->assertSame('page', $mobile['nav-dashboard-mobile']['aria-current']);

        // AC2 — exactly one current item per variant, and it is the same item.
        $currentDesktop = array_keys(array_filter(
            $desktop,
            static fn (array $link): bool => $link['aria-current'] === 'page',
        ));
        $currentMobile = array_keys(array_filter(
            $mobile,
            static fn (array $link): bool => $link['aria-current'] === 'page',
        ));

        $this->assertSame(['nav-dashboard'], $currentDesktop);
        $this->assertSame(['nav-dashboard-mobile'], $currentMobile);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function every_link_carries_a_stable_item_derived_scroll_key_shared_by_both_variants(): void
    {
        $items = $this->navItems();

        $desktop = $this->links($this->renderNav('desktop', $items));
        $mobile = $this->links($this->renderNav('mobile', $items));
        $desktopAgain = $this->links($this->renderNav('desktop', $items));

        $keys = [];

        foreach ($items as $item) {
            $testid = $item['data_testid'];
            $desktopKey = $desktop[$testid]['data-scroll-key'] ?? null;
            $mobileKey = $mobile[$testid . '-mobile']['data-scroll-key'] ?? null;

            $this->assertNotNull($desktopKey, "Desktop link {$testid} must expose a scroll-restoration key.");
            $this->assertNotSame('', $desktopKey, "Desktop link {$testid} scroll key must not be empty.");

            // AC4 — same item ⇒ same key across variants.
            $this->assertSame($desktopKey, $mobileKey, "Scroll key for {$testid} must match across variants.");

            // AC4 — stable across requests (re-render yields the same key).
            $this->assertSame($desktopKey, $desktopAgain[$testid]['data-scroll-key'] ?? null);

            $keys[] = $desktopKey;
        }

        // AC4 — derived from the navigation item, so distinct items get distinct keys.
        $this->assertSame($keys, array_values(array_unique($keys)));
    }

    #[Test]
    public function existing_filtering_badge_href_and_testid_behaviour_is_preserved(): void
    {
        $items = $this->navItems();

        $desktopHtml = $this->renderNav('desktop', $items);
        $mobileHtml = $this->renderNav('mobile', $items, ['tenant-billing']);

        $desktop = $this->links($desktopHtml);
        $mobile = $this->links($mobileHtml);

        // AC6 — hrefs unchanged.
        $this->assertSame(route('user.dashboard'), $desktop['nav-dashboard']['href']);
        $this->assertSame(route('events.index'), $desktop['nav-events']['href']);

        // AC6 — badge still rendered.
        $this->assertStringContainsString('7', $desktopHtml);
        $this->assertMatchesRegularExpression('/<span[^>]*>\s*7\s*<\/span>/', $desktopHtml);

        // AC6 — exclusion list still filters, AC3 — mobile keeps its distinct test ids.
        $this->assertArrayNotHasKey('nav-billing-mobile', $mobile);
        $this->assertSame(
            ['nav-dashboard-mobile', 'nav-events-mobile'],
            array_keys($mobile),
        );
        $this->assertSame(
            [],
            array_intersect(array_keys($desktop), array_keys($mobile)),
        );
    }

    #[Test]
    public function authenticated_layout_emits_a_scroll_restoration_region_marker_for_the_page(): void
    {
        $user = $this->verifiedUser();
        $team = Team::factory()->create(['user_id' => $user->id, 'personal_team' => false]);
        $team->users()->syncWithoutDetaching([
            $user->getKey() => ['role' => UserRole::ADMIN->value],
        ]);
        $user->switchTeam($team);

        $marker = function (User $user, string $routeName): string {
            $response = $this->actingAs($user)->get(route($routeName));
            $response->assertOk();

            $matched = preg_match(
                '/data-scroll-region="([^"]+)"/',
                $response->getContent(),
                $found,
            );

            $this->assertSame(
                1,
                $matched,
                "The authenticated layout must emit a scroll-restoration region marker on {$routeName}.",
            );

            return $found[1];
        };

        $personal = $marker($user, 'account.personal');
        $personalAgain = $marker($user, 'account.personal');
        $security = $marker($user, 'account.security');

        // AC5 — stable for the same page so Back/Forward can restore its offset…
        $this->assertSame($personal, $personalAgain);

        // …and it identifies the page being rendered, so a different page differs.
        $this->assertNotSame($personal, $security);
    }
}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ATDD-MIN-1 verification wrapper. Runs the capsule's focused verification and
# records wall-clock command runtime to a ledger outside the repository, so
# active agent time can be separated from test-command runtime symmetrically
# across both arms.
set -uo pipefail

LEDGER="${ATDD_VERIFY_LEDGER:-/dev/null}"
export DB_CONNECTION=mysql
export DB_HOST=127.0.0.1
export DB_PORT=3306
export DB_USERNAME=root
export DB_DATABASE="${ATDD_TEST_DB:-jakomeet_testing}"
unset DB_PASSWORD

start=$(python3 -c 'import time;print(time.time())')
vendor/bin/phpunit --configuration=.atdd-phpunit.xml "$@"
status=$?
end=$(python3 -c 'import time;print(time.time())')

python3 - "$LEDGER" "$start" "$end" "$status" "$*" <<'PY'
import json, sys
ledger, start, end, status, argv = sys.argv[1], float(sys.argv[2]), float(sys.argv[3]), int(sys.argv[4]), sys.argv[5]
if ledger != "/dev/null":
    with open(ledger, "a") as fh:
        fh.write(json.dumps({"start": start, "end": end, "seconds": round(end - start, 3), "status": status, "args": argv}) + "\n")
PY

exit $status

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Providers;

use App\Models\User;
use App\Navigation\NavigationResolver;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;
use Illuminate\Support\ServiceProvider;
use Platform\UiNavigation\BreadcrumbBuilder;
use Platform\UiNavigation\Contracts\AdminResolverInterface;

class PlatformNavigationServiceProvider extends ServiceProvider
{
    public function register(): void
    {
        $this->app->bind(AdminResolverInterface::class, fn() => new class implements AdminResolverInterface {
            public function isAdmin(\Illuminate\Contracts\Auth\Authenticatable $user): bool
            {
                return $user instanceof User && $user->isSystemAdmin();
            }
        });

    }

    public function boot(): void
    {
        // Share breadcrumbs with every view so in-container placements work
        // (Livewire full-page components render the content view before the
        // layout, so a layout-only composer fires too late).
        // once() ensures BreadcrumbBuilder->build() runs at most once per request.
        view()->composer('*', function ($view): void {
            $user = Auth::user();

            if (!$user instanceof User) {
                return;
            }

            if (array_key_exists('breadcrumbs', $view->getData())) {
                return;
            }

            $breadcrumbs = once(fn () => $this->app->make(BreadcrumbBuilder::class)->build($user, $user->isSystemAdmin()));
            $view->with('breadcrumbs', $breadcrumbs);
        });

        view()->composer(['layouts.authenticated'], function ($view): void {
            $user = Auth::user();

            if (!$user instanceof User) {
                return;
            }

            $resolver = $this->app->make(NavigationResolver::class);
            $allItems = $resolver->resolve($user);

            $placedBuckets = ['user-menu', 'workspace-sidebar', 'account-sidebar'];
            $buckets = ['main' => [], 'user-menu' => [], 'workspace-sidebar' => [], 'account-sidebar' => []];
            foreach ($allItems as $item) {
                $placement = $item['placement'] ?? null;
                $bucket = \in_array($placement, $placedBuckets, true) ? $placement : 'main';
                $buckets[$bucket][] = $item;
            }

            if (request()->routeIs('admin.*')) {
                $buckets['main'] = array_values(array_filter(
                    $buckets['main'],
                    static fn (array $item): bool => str_starts_with((string) ($item['key'] ?? ''), 'super-admin-'),
                ));

                $buckets['user-menu'] = array_values(array_filter(
                    $buckets['user-menu'],
                    static fn (array $item): bool => ($item['key'] ?? null) !== 'user-workspace',
                ));
            }

            $breadcrumbs = $this->app->make(BreadcrumbBuilder::class)->build($user, $user->isSystemAdmin());

            $view->with([
                'navigationMenu' => $buckets['main'],
                'userMenu' => $buckets['user-menu'],
                'workspaceSidebarMenu' => $buckets['workspace-sidebar'],
                'accountSidebarMenu' => $buckets['account-sidebar'],
                'breadcrumbs' => $breadcrumbs,
            ]);
        });
    }

}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Navigation;

use App\Models\User;
use Platform\UiNavigation\ActiveStateResolver;
use Platform\UiNavigation\NavigationBuilder;

/**
 * Single entry-point for resolving navigation items for a user.
 *
 * Owns the cache key + active-state pipeline so the view composer and
 * render-context-independent components (e.g. WorkspaceSidebar) both go
 * through the same code path and hit the same cache.
 */
class NavigationResolver
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly NavigationBuilder $builder,
        private readonly ActiveStateResolver $activeStates,
    ) {}

    /**
     * Resolve the full, capability-filtered, active-state-decorated menu.
     *
     * @return array<int, array<string, mixed>>
     */
    public function resolve(User $user): array
    {
        $menu = $this->cached($user);

        return $this->activeStates->updateActiveStates($menu);
    }

    /**
     * Resolve items for a specific placement (or null for main nav — items
     * without any placement set).
     *
     * @return array<int, array<string, mixed>>
     */
    public function byPlacement(User $user, ?string $placement): array
    {
        return array_values(array_filter(
            $this->resolve($user),
            static fn (array $item): bool => ($item['placement'] ?? null) === $placement,
        ));
    }

    /**
     * @return array<int, array<string, mixed>>
     */
    private function cached(User $user): array
    {
        $cacheDuration = (int) config('platform-navigation.cache_duration', 3600);

        if ($cacheDuration <= 0) {
            return $this->builder->build($user, $user->current_team_id);
        }

        $cacheKey = 'platform_nav_' . $user->id . '_' . ($user->current_team_id ?? 'no_team');

        return cache()->remember(
            $cacheKey,
            $cacheDuration,
            fn(): array => $this->builder->build($user, $user->current_team_id),
        );
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Platform\UiNavigation;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;

/**
 * Resolves active state for navigation items based on the current request route.
 *
 * Stateless — instantiate with a Request or resolve from the container.
 */
class ActiveStateResolver
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly Request $request,
    ) {}

    /**
     * Check if a route is currently active.
     * Matches the exact route or any route under its prefix (e.g. show, edit, create).
     */
    public function isRouteActive(string $route, bool $exact = false): bool
    {
        $currentRoute = $this->request->route()?->getName();

        if (! $currentRoute) {
            return false;
        }

        $isExactMatch = $currentRoute === $route;

        if ($exact || $isExactMatch) {
            return $isExactMatch;
        }

        // Derive the route prefix by stripping the terminal action segment
        // e.g. "admin.tickets.index" → "admin.tickets"
        // Any route under that prefix (show, edit, create, …) is considered active.
        $prefix = preg_replace('/\.(index|show|create|edit|store|update|destroy)$/', '', $route);

        return str_starts_with($currentRoute, "{$prefix}.");
    }

    /**
     * Update active states in a cached menu structure.
     *
     * Menu items must carry a `_key` field (set during build) so
     * we can recalculate without re-reading config.
     *
     * @param  array<int, array<string, mixed>>  $menu
     * @return array<int, array<string, mixed>>
     */
    public function updateActiveStates(array $menu): array
    {
        foreach ($menu as $index => $item) {

namespace Platform\UiNavigation;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;

/**
 * Resolves active state for navigation items based on the current request route.
 *
 * Stateless — instantiate with a Request or resolve from the container.
 */
class ActiveStateResolver
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly Request $request,
    ) {}

    /**
     * Check if a route is currently active.
     * Matches the exact route or any route under its prefix (e.g. show, edit, create).
     */
    public function isRouteActive(string $route, bool $exact = false): bool
    {
        $currentRoute = $this->request->route()?->getName();

        if (! $currentRoute) {
            return false;
        }

        $isExactMatch = $currentRoute === $route;

        if ($exact || $isExactMatch) {
            return $isExactMatch;
        }

        // Derive the route prefix by stripping the terminal action segment
        // e.g. "admin.tickets.index" → "admin.tickets"
        // Any route under that prefix (show, edit, create, …) is considered active.
        $prefix = preg_replace('/\.(index|show|create|edit|store|update|destroy)$/', '', $route);

        return str_starts_with($currentRoute, "{$prefix}.");
    }

    /**
     * Update active states in a cached menu structure.
     *
     * Menu items must carry a `_key` field (set during build) so
     * we can recalculate without re-reading config.
     *
     * @param  array<int, array<string, mixed>>  $menu
     * @return array<int, array<string, mixed>>
     */
    public function updateActiveStates(array $menu): array
    {
        foreach ($menu as $index => $item) {
            if (($item['type'] ?? null) === 'section' && isset($item['items'])) {
                $sectionActive = false;

                foreach ($item['items'] as $childIndex => $child) {
                    if (isset($child['route'])) {
                        $active = $this->isRouteActive($child['route'], (bool) ($child['active_exact'] ?? false));
                        $menu[$index]['items'][$childIndex]['active'] = $active;
                        if ($active) {
                            $sectionActive = true;
                        }
                    }

                $menu[$index]['active'] = $sectionActive;

                $menu[$index]['active'] = $this->isRouteActive($item['route'], (bool) ($item['active_exact'] ?? false));
            }
        }

        return $menu;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Navigation;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;

/**
 * Server-rendered half of the scroll-restoration contract.
 *
 * The front end remembers the offset of the region it is leaving
 * (`data-scroll-region`) and restores it when the same page is rendered again
 * on Back/Forward. Primary nav links carry the key of the item they belong to
 * (`data-scroll-key`) so that bookkeeping does not depend on which rendering
 * variant — desktop bar or mobile drawer — the user actually clicked.
 *
 * Both keys are pure functions of what they describe: the same item, and the
 * same page, always produce the same string.
 */
final class ScrollRestoration
{
    /**
     * Key for a navigation item, identical in every rendering variant.
     *
     * Derived only from identifiers that do not move between requests — never
     * from the label, which is translated and would change with the locale.
     *
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $item
     */
    public static function itemKey(array $item): string
    {
        $source = $item['key'] ?? $item['route'] ?? $item['data_testid'] ?? null;

        return 'nav:' . (self::normalize((string) $source) ?: 'unknown');
    }

    /**
     * Marker for the page currently being rendered.
     *
     * Route parameters are part of the page identity (/events/1 and /events/2
     * are different pages); the query string is not, so one page keeps a single
     * offset across filter and sort changes.
     */
    public static function regionKey(?Request $request = null): string
    {
        $request ??= request();
        $route = $request?->route();
        $name = $route?->getName();

        if ($name === null || $name === '') {
            return 'page:' . (self::normalize(trim((string) $request?->path(), '/')) ?: 'root');
        }

        $parameters = array_map(
            static fn ($value): string => self::normalize((string) $value),
            array_values(array_filter($route->originalParameters(), 'is_scalar')),
        );

        return 'page:' . implode(':', [self::normalize($name), ...$parameters]);
    }

    /**
     * Reduce a raw identifier to characters that are safe and predictable in an
     * HTML attribute and in client-side storage keys.
     */
    private static function normalize(string $value): string
    {
        return trim((string) preg_replace('/[^A-Za-z0-9._\/-]+/', '-', $value), '-');
    }
}
